crossRefs.note: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his…
He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did…
but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his…
for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

translations.web: Your servant had two sons, and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other, and killed him.
translations.bsb: And your maidservant had two sons who were fighting in the field with no one to separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.
translations.kjv: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
translations.asv: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and killed him.
